description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from Whisper for several models, specifically SESHA ft and NESAC ft. The vertical axis displays the model names – Dates, Americanisms, Optimisation applications – Remove Spacing, Add Spacing, and Optimisation applications – Add Spacing – with labels listed in that order from bottom to top. The horizontal axis, labeled “Difference in Average WER from Whisper,” represents the WER difference, with a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.003, with tick labels at 0.000, 0.001, 0.002, and 0.003. Each model is represented by two horizontal bars: one orange representing “NESAC ft model” and one green representing “SESHA ft model.” The bars are arranged side-by-side for each model. For the “Dates” model, the green bar extends to approximately 0.00228, while the orange bar reaches approximately 0.00257. The “Optimisation applications – Add Spacing” model has the tallest bars, with the green bar reaching approximately 0.00344 and the orange bar reaching approximately 0.00313. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
